endpoint_url: Dynamo frontend (OpenAI-compatible HTTP API) on the server node

node_types.host_memory_configuration: LPDDR5X SOCAMM; two NUMA nodes, one per Vera CPU (MemTotal 745,599,040 kB and 753,862,912 kB)
node_types.host_network_card_count: 10: 8 ConnectX-9 (InfiniBand, 800 Gb/s XDR each) and 2 BlueField-4 integrated network controllers (2 Ethernet ports each, 400 Gb/s)
node_types.host_storage_capacity: 32.6 TB (4 x 7.68 TB + 1 x 1.92 TB NVMe)
node_types.host_storage_type: NVMe SSD: 4 x Micron MTFDMBT7T6THM 7.68 TB and 1 x Micron MTFDLBT1T9THG 1.92 TB; /raid is a 6.0 TB ext4 LVM volume used as per-allocation scratch
node_types.hw_notes: The client topology differs by point: at C32 to C512 the benchmark client runs on a second node allocated with the server (its GPUs idle) and reaches the Dynamo frontend over the server node's 400 Gb/s BlueField-4 Ethernet port in one routed hop (TCP connect p50 0.389 ms); at C1024 it runs on eight physical cores of the server node reserved outside the CPU masks of the frontend and the vLLM workers and reaches the frontend over loopback with no hops (TCP connect p50 0.045 ms). docs/software_disclosure.md lists the placement of every point and the latency measurement.
node_types.filesystem: Shared Lustre for persistent files; per-allocation RAID for model and compilation scratch
node_types.sw_notes: vLLM (YibaiMeng/vllm), branch mlperf-end-multiturn-v1.0-qwen-v2 at commit 77d1e9a77d3a7f2adb96e13478207c4ed8dfad2c, behind Dynamo 1.4.2

node_config: Four active GPUs on one node, each running one TP1 vLLM worker behind a Dynamo frontend.

weights.transformation: Online MXFP8 from the published BF16 checkpoint, using the pinned image implementation and its recorded quantization exclusions. The target model's lm_head stays BF16. The MTP drafter computes its draft logits with an MXFP8 copy of that BF16 lm_head, quantized once at load without calibration data, when a draft step has at most 128 rows (VLLM_MTP_DRAFT_LM_HEAD_MXFP8=1, VLLM_MTP_DRAFT_LM_HEAD_MXFP8_MAX_M=128), and with the BF16 lm_head when it has more; the target verifies every draft token with its BF16 lm_head.
